answer_1.quote: Generating multi-party empathetic dialogues faces two challenges... We present a novel natural language processing task called Multi-Party Empathetic Dialogue Generation.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation Criteria We calculate the AVG BLEU (average of BLEU-1,-2,-3,-4) and ROUGE-L scores as evaluations of model response generation...

answer_4.quote: We resorted to the Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdsourcing platform to evaluate three artificial indicators (i.e., Empathy, Relevance, and Fluency).
answer_4.guideline: Rate each response between 1 and 5 on Empathy, Relevance, and Fluency.
